name: Setsugekka
message: 「I, I’m back—！」
I hurriedly changed into my Spirit-Type Armament and dashed to the entrance, only to find Muragaki-sensei already standing by.

name: Iori
message: 「……Setsugekka, you’re barely making it in time.」
I was immediately on the receiving end of a cold look from Muragaki-sensei.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S, sorry! I got the east and west gates mixed up…… and ran into Igarashi-senpai.」

name: Iori
message: 「You really are hopeless.」
He chuckled. I was glad to see Sensei enjoying himself, at least.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, Setsugekka, let’s do a final check.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, please do!」
We did a final verification of my Origami and Spirit-Type Armament fitting before entering the venue.
They check for any flaws, defects, or abnormalities here, and apparently, they can disqualify or ban you from competing depending on the findings.
It was Muragaki-sensei doing the checking. He wasn't acting as my Second, but he was helping with the adjustments.

name: Iori
message: 「First, let's check your vitals.」
As Sensei operated the terminal, an indicator appeared. I glanced at it every now and then.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, activate your Origami for me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: （I think this is the first time I’ve had a check like this. It’s like… a final exam for participating in the Martial Festival.）

name: Iori
message: 「……Setsugekka? I can’t run the check if you don’t activate the Origami.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, right, right! Origami activation, got it!」
I hurriedly activated my Origami.
The indicator reacted, and Sensei began verifying the numbers and whatnot.

name: Iori
message: 「Link between Origami and Spirit-Type Armament…… confirmed. Barrier Jacket levels are normal. Now for the Origami……」
He checked each item one by one with great care. It’s a bit tedious, but if you don't do it, you can’t even enter.

name: Setsugekka
message: （So this is the Martial Festival…… it’s not just about rushing in and fighting, huh~）
It felt like a moment meant to drive that fact home.

name: Iori
message: 「Mental Resonance Coefficient…… hmm, it’s actually a bit higher than usual.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright…… all conditions green！ You’re ready to be sent out at any time.」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Ah, shoot…… I’m suddenly getting nervous!）

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, the check is done. Hey…… earth to Setsugekka？ What’s the matter？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, y-yes！ Thank you very much！」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you alright？ You look a bit spaced out.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, um, how should I put it... I’m just... I’m feeling a little nervous.」
How pathetic of me, when I stormed out of Kei-chan’s place swearing I’d absolutely become a Toujinegi.

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Well, you’re still a first-year, Setsugekka, and this is your first big stage.」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyone would be nervous for their first main tournament match.」
That’s right, this is the main tournament. It’s different from the qualifiers.
No matter if it’s by coincidence or a momentary slip-up, if I lose, it ends here.
There are no do―overs. To become a Toujinegi, I cannot afford a single mistake―

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh, Teacher... I wonder if I can win...」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, that’s not like you, Setsugekka. You’re sounding weak.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But, but...！」

name: Iori
message: 「You’ve done everything you could up to this point, Setsugekka. Haven’t you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s... yeah. I think I’ve given it my all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Right. I’ve been watching you closely, so I can say this with certainty.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’ll be fine, Setsugekka. You’re plenty strong. No matter who the opponent is, you won’t lose！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Se—Teacher... Yes! Thank you...!」
Kei-chan, and Muragaki-sensei too. Thank you for always being by my side.
Because of you, I was able to become strong. So, let’s stay together from now on—

name: Umpire
message: 「From the west―Martial Arts Division first―year, Special Grade A, belonging to the ‘Takamura Class’! Kazamine Setsugekkaーーーーーーーーーーーーーー!!」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, it’s your turn, Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right...！ I’m going, Teacher！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah！ Go out there and cut loose as much as you want！！」
Receiving my teacher’s words of encouragement and smile at my back, I head to the stage—！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wow, this is amazing...！」
Stepping onto the stage, the pressure of the cheers is incomparable to when I was watching from the audience seats.
Gazes and voices from every direction. Plus, large cameras are pointed right at me—

name: Setsugekka
message: （It’s not just the audience here. People all over Japan are watching me right now...！）
Thinking that, an emotion that’s a mix of nervousness and excitement comes surging up in me.

name: Spectator A
message: 「Go for it！ First-year！」

name: Spectator B
message: 「I'm cheering for you！」
Hearing cheers like that, I hurriedly try waving back with a smile.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Victoria-senpai really is amazing, huh. Staying so composed in a crowd like this）
It might be a little too hard for me...

name: Setsugekka
message: （It's okay—even if I can't do it like Victoria-senpai, I'm still me！）
Across from me, Igarashi Taiga-senpai is already standing on the east side.
He fixes a sharp glare right on me, never once looking away.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Whoa... he's kinda scary...！）
No, this isn't the time to be losing my nerve.
I promised Kei-chan, didn't I? That I'd definitely become the Toujinegi.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hhh... haaaah...」
I take a deep breath in and let it out. Exhaling all the bad energy, I glare right back at my opponent.

name: Umpire
message: 「Both sides, take your stances！！」
I draw my Origami—and fill my entire body with strength.
It's okay, I can win. Because Kei-chan told me so, didn't she?

name: Setsugekka
message: （I am Kazamine Setsugekka—the strongest swordswoman of the Kazamine...！！）

name: Umpire
message: 「Gather the eight million gods in divine assembly, hold counsel in divine deliberation. Purity of heaven and earth, purity of the six senses—purify us, cleanse us...！」

name: Umpire
message: 「To the east, Igarashi Taiga！」

name: Umpire
message: 「To the west, Kazamine Setsugekka！」

name: Umpire
message: 「―Spirits high, square off―no false starts！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ha... haaah, haaaaaaah...！！！」
Breathing out heavily—I reach down into the depths of the darkness within me.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Come on, it's your turn, "Mizuchi"―my other self―！！）
Explosive Tenju swells up from the very core of my body.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Now then, shall we begin...！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Now, fight fair and square—begin！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I coooooome！！！」
Setsugekka, returning with unsteady steps after her match.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka... Hey, Setsugekka！」
I rush over and catch her swaying body.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you alright? Are you hurt！?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh... Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Stay with me, Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why are you here... um, what about the match？」

name: Iori
message: 「What about the match... you don't remember？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, I remember right up until it started, but...」
She looks around nervously.

name: Iori
message: 「I see... it's okay. The match is over.」
She must have used her inner divine power in such a high-pressure environment that her memory has become fuzzy.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, it's over... what was the result！？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Congratulations, Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「You won！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Won... wait, I won？ I really won！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, you're advancing to the semifinals, Setsugekka！！」
A sparkle returns to Setsugekka's eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I did it... I really did it!!!!」
Setsugekka hugs me tightly.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I... I really won, I actually pulled it off！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, your opponent, Taiga Igarashi, was top-class even among the third-years in the Martial Arts Division.」

name: Iori
message: 「It was a magnificent match; you didn't give him a chance.」

name: Iori
message: 「This is the result of you learning to control your rampage. Today's performance was a perfect hundred！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... this is all thanks to you, Sensei！ Thank you so much！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, it's too early to thank me. We still have the semifinals and the finals left to go.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that's right.」

name: Iori
message: 「Especially since your next opponent is Victoria.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's get some good rest today, get in top shape, and give it our all for what comes next！」
Setsugekka's vigorous reply made me even happier.
